Defaults for the wrapped heatmap module

Source: R/heatmap_wrapper_helpers.R
INTERNAL_heatmap_defaults.Rd

Fixes the base's matrix columns, row-name column and annotation key to the wrapper's frame; base carries the wrapper's own heatmap defaults, which a caller's defaults override entry by entry.

Usage

.heatmap_defaults(
  frame,
  defaults = NULL,
  base = list(),
  wrapper.keys = character(0)
)

Arguments

frame

A result of .heatmap_frame().

defaults

The caller's defaults, or NULL.

base

The wrapper's heatmap defaults.

wrapper.keys

The wrapper's own input ids, dropped before the list reaches the base module.

Value

A named list of defaults for VizModules::ComplexHeatmap_HeatmapServer().

Jared Andrews
